known_deviations.source: ICLR 2024 iTransformer; inverted embedding, encoder and time-axis projection transcribed from github.com/thuml/Time-Series-Library (models/iTransformer.py, layers/Embed.py, layers/Transformer_EncDec.py, layers/SelfAttention_Family.py).
known_deviations.scope_note: The release ships an anomaly-detection script for MSL only, and this artifact's corpus contains no point-adjusted iTransformer number for these datasets (CATCH reports it in the affiliation family). The detector therefore runs on MSL as a diagnostic model: it tests whether the residual MSL gap follows the attention family, and it produces no verdict row.
known_deviations.budget_note: Only MSL's budget is published by the release. The other four datasets reuse the same budget (d_model 128, three layers, 10 epochs, batch 128) and their alarm ratios follow the dataset configs; because the budget is not the release's own for those datasets, their rows are reported only in the affiliation-family cross-check against CATCH and never as verdicts.

source_model_configuration.boundary: Full local baseline comparison, not historical author-harness equivalence; original known deviations remain explicit. USAD signed-loss control may be unstable and must be reported as such.
